title: Going to the dentist.
lines: Today is a special day for Noor.
She's going to the dentist for the first time.
Noor is five years old and she's a little bit nervous.
Mummy, what does a dentist actually do?
Mummy is buttering a slice of bread.
A dentist checks whether your teeth are healthy, says Mummy.
You use them to bite into an apple, and to chew your sandwich.
And you use them to smile!
Twenty little white teeth, she says.
After breakfast Noor brushes her teeth.
For two minutes, with her pink toothbrush and a little bit of toothpaste.
And at the back too, where the big teeth are.
Then they drive to the dentist.
In the waiting room there are books and a big box of toys.
A little boy is sitting there with his daddy.
It tickles a little, that's all.
A woman comes out in a white coat with a friendly smile.
The room is bright and clean.
In the middle stands a big blue chair.
Would you like to sit in my special chair?
It can go up and down, just like a lift.
And then it tilts back a little.
Above her head hangs a big lamp.
Look, these are my little helpers.
She shows her a little mirror on a long handle.
With this little mirror I can look behind your teeth.
May I have a look in your mouth?
Open really wide, like a lion.
Noor opens her mouth really wide.
Doctor Sara looks at every tooth.
She counts them, just like Mummy.
Then she may take a sip of water and rinse.
And then pft, spit it out into a little sink next to the chair.
Doctor Sara also shows her a big set of plastic teeth and a giant toothbrush.
Look, this is how you brush.
And do you know what teeth don't like very much?
Lots of sweets and fizzy drinks, says Doctor Sara.
They give you holes in your teeth.
But water, fruit, cheese and vegetables make your teeth happy.
Doctor Sara gives her a sticker with a smiling tooth.
And a new toothbrush, a purple one.
Milan is still in the waiting room.
It really did tickle a little!
On the way back in the car Noor looks at her sticker.
Mummy, she says, can I go to Doctor Sara again next year?
That evening Noor brushes her teeth with her new purple toothbrush.
